adverseImpact.title: Adverse impact — four-fifths rule
adverseImpact.hint: The selection rate (hired ÷ applications) of every group must be at least 80% of the best scoring group (EEOC four-fifths rule). Groups smaller than {{min}} are statistically too small for a verdict.
adverseImpact.empty: No applications in the selected period.
adverseImpact.insufficientHint: Fewer than {{min}} applications — too small for a statistically reliable verdict, therefore suppressed.
adverseImpact.noReference: No group reaches the minimum group size of {{min}} — impact ratios cannot be determined.

aiUsage.title: AI usage per month
aiUsage.hint: Number of AI operations per month from the append-only AI register (ai_events), broken down by feature. Counts only — no content.
aiUsage.empty: No AI usage logged in the selected period.

matchScores.title: Match score distribution
matchScores.hint: Histogram of all AI match scores (0–100%). A healthy distribution is broad; a peak on one side may indicate a data issue or bias.
matchScores.empty: No match scores computed in the selected period.
